phases.name: Ready
phases.observation: Wide stance, both feet on floor, arms bent and hands held ahead of torso.

phases.name: Gather
phases.observation: Feet draw closer, weight shifts over the leg remaining on floor; body turns slightly toward screen-left.

phases.name: Chamber
phases.observation: Kicking thigh rises toward screen-left with knee flexed; hands remain raised.

phases.name: Snap extension
phases.observation: Lower leg projects outward/up toward screen-left, approaching a straight knee. Torso inclines away from kicking side; base foot remains near same floor position.

phases.name: Recoil
phases.observation: Knee flexes again while thigh stays lifted; foot retracts before being lowered.

phases.name: Return
phases.observation: Kicking foot lowers back to floor, stance widens and torso returns upright.

phases.name: Ready hold
phases.observation: Both feet down in wide stance, hands remain raised.

support: Apparent single-foot support during chamber/extension/recoil; load, heel/toe pivot and pressure unknown
